objectives_fil: Matutukoy ang hazard, lokal na safety requirements at reporting contact bago ang gawain.
Maihahanda ang lugar, kagamitan at PPE ayon sa panganib at saklaw ng pagsasanay.
Maipapakita ang ligtas na gawain para sa sharps, infection prevention at pangangalaga sa katawan.
Maiuulat ang insidente o kulang na proteksyon at maipapaliwanag ang agarang referral kapag kailangan.
objectives_en: Identify hazards, local safety requirements and reporting contacts before a task.
Prepare the area, equipment and PPE for the hazards and scope of training.
Demonstrate safe practices for sharps, infection prevention and protection of the body.
Report an incident or protection gap and explain immediate referral when needed.
summary_fil: Ang araw ni Ana ay ligtas kapag may kontrol bago magsimula: maayos na lugar, tamang kagamitan at malinaw na contact. Magkakaiba ang pag-iwas sa sharps injury, impeksyon, init, pagkapagod at aksidente, kaya kailangang itapat ang proteksyon sa panganib. Ang exposure ay nangangailangan ng agarang report at evaluation, kahit walang sintomas. Ang paghinto sa hindi ligtas na gawain at paghingi ng suporta ay bahagi ng maaasahang serbisyo.
summary_en: Ana’s day is safer when controls are ready before work: a suitable area, correct equipment and a clear contact. Sharps injuries, infection, heat, fatigue and accidents need different controls. An exposure needs immediate reporting and evaluation even without symptoms. Pausing unsafe work and requesting support are part of dependable service.
